description: LLM Critic rubric for Azure Load Balancer operations

checks: Load balancer provisioningState is Succeeded or Failed
frontendIPConfigurations have valid private or public IP assignments
backendAddressPools reference valid VM NICs or IP configurations
loadBalancingRules match the expected frontend/backend/probe combination
Delete Load Balancer operations include pre-confirmation show command
No credential or sensitive data in stdout/stderr
Load balancer deletion warns about traffic disruption to all backend pools
Inbound NAT rule removal checks for impact on existing VM RDP/SSH access
Re-running the same command produces consistent output
Backend pool member addition is idempotent (VM already in pool is not an error)
Probe creation checks for probe name conflicts
Delete operations on already-deleted load balancers return success
Command, exit_code, stdout, and stderr are all captured
Timestamp and iteration count are recorded
Frontend IP configurations and allocation methods are documented
Health probe configuration and backend pool membership are logged
All commands include --output json flag
Resource group is specified with --resource-group
Load balancer name follows Azure naming conventions
SKU (Basic/Standard) is specified for Load Balancer creation
